messages.text: Our dad died and left the house in his will. My sister A wants to buy it with her husband at a "family discount". I'm not signing off on that. Our younger sister B could use some money too. Can you help us sort this out?

I’m sorry about Dad. My husband and I would like to buy the house at a family discount, but C hasn’t agreed, and we can’t proceed without her agreement. No price or deadline is settled. I need more time before signing anything.

I’d like some money to help me start a dance studio, though I’m not sure yet what amount or timing would be realistic. I have no firm deadline. I’m a little concerned about agreeing to a discounted sale before we’ve talked everything through, so I’d rather not sign anything yet.
